frequency_question: How often does the Federal Reserve Board successfully complete a formal macroprudential capital rule adjustment from proposal to final vote within a multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory rulemaking process initiated by the Federal Reserve Board to alter bank capital buffers, stress test parameters, or macroprudential requirements. Excludes routine monetary policy rate decisions.

cases.name: Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Final Rule

coverage_note: 4 named major capital rulemakings; population represents the complete set of primary structural capital standard overhauls by the Board.
known_gaps: None; the administrative process for capital rules is uniform under the Administrative Procedure Act.
skeleton: Regulatory rulemakings completed by the Fed Board of Governors since Dodd-Frank framework establishment.
multiplier: 4 completed major capital framework rulemakings divided by 4 initiated major capital framework rulemakings within multi-year operational horizons.
validity_reason: The statutory requirements of the Administrative Procedure Act and the internal governance structure of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors remain stable across these horizons.
